Before moving day

  • Confirm management move rules, freight lift booking, and security ID lists for truck plate and crew.
  • Declutter to reduce volume; label rooms and mark FRAGILE on electronics and glass.
  • Photograph meters and wall condition at origin; repeat at destination before furniture covers walls.
  • Check holiday traffic and end-of-month rush when picking dates.
